*
 -2-  NC: 2023:KHC-K:6452  CRL.P No. 200273 of 2023  THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 439 OF CR.P.C. PRAYING

TO RELEASE THE PETITIONERS ON BAIL IN CRIME No.46/2022 OF MUDHOL POLICE STATION, GULBARGA, FOR THE OFFENCES PUNISHABLE UNDER SECTIONS 498A, 302 AND 201 READ WITH SECTION 34 OF IPC, PENDING BEFORE THE IV ADDITIONAL SESSIONS JUDGE AT KALABURAGI, SITTING AT SEDAM.

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo for withdrawal of the petition.
Memo is taken on record.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
